definitions.gloss: commemorative ceremony; memorial ceremony; anniversary event
definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony held to mark an anniversary, milestone, or significant event. Common for school anniversaries, company milestones, and national commemorations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧50⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{来賓|らいひん}→来賓：28580_raihin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧。
examples.english: Many distinguished guests were invited to the commemorative ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧100⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}み→歩み：13195_ayumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the city's 100th anniversary ceremony, the mayor gave a speech looking back on its history.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal compound combining ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧ (commemoration) with ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧ (ceremony). Typically features speeches, awards, and formal proceedings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧ (to hold a commemorative ceremony)
- {記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧ (to attend a commemorative ceremony)
- ⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん} (founding anniversary ceremony)
- {開校|かいこう}{記念|きねん}{式典|しきてん} (school founding ceremony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧: ceremony — the general word for a formal ceremony
- ⟦{祝賀会|しゅくがかい}→祝賀会：17147_shukugakai⟧: celebration party — less formal than a ceremony
